DeletePolicy.description: Deletion policy. Required when the task type is Delete (TaskAction = Delete).

DeleteTimeBefore.description: Specify the deletion time (data before this time will be deleted), in milliseconds.

Rule.description: Deletion rule. DELETE_TYPE_ONLY_FS: Delete only objects in the file system; DELETE_TYPE_FS_WITH_LATEST_OBJECT: Delete objects in the file system and their latest TOS object versions; DELETE_TYPE_FS_WITH_ALLVERSION_OBJECT: Delete objects in the file system and all their TOS object versions.

EntryListFileInfo.description: List file information for task execution.

FileBucket.description: TOS bucket containing the list file for task execution. Required when using a list file from the user's TOS bucket for preheating or settling.

FileKey.description: Identifier for the list file used in task execution. For local list files, this is the identifier returned by CreatePreSignedUrl; for list files in the user's TOS bucket, this is the object path of the list file.

FileName.description: Name of the list file for task execution. Required when using either a local list file or a list file from the user's TOS bucket for preheating or settling.

Type.description: Report type. TotalFiles: all files; FailedFiles: failure report; SuccessFiles: success report; InventoryFiles: reconciliation report.

ProjectUrl.description: Redirect URL for the TLS log project.

TopicEmbeddedUrl.description: Embedded address of the TLS log topic.

TopicUrl.description: Redirect URL for TLS log topic.

description: vePFS data flow task. Used to perform preheating (Import), settling (Export), reconciliation (Inventory), and deletion (Delete) operations between the vePFS file system and TOS bucket.

DataType.description: Data type operated on by the task. Metadata: Metadata; MetaAndData: Metadata and data.

DeletePolicy.description: Deletion policy. Required when the task type is Delete (TaskAction = Delete).

EnableTlsLog.description: Whether to enable TLS log analysis. Only provided in the create request; the server responds with detailed information via TlsInfo.

EntryListFileInfo.description: List file information for task execution.

EntryListFileUrl.description: Download link for the list file used in task execution.

ExecCount.description: Completed operations (applies to preheating and settling tasks).

ExportSymlinkPolicy.description: Export task symlink handling policy. Skip: skip symlink files; NormalFile: export as independent files.

FailedCount.description: Total number of failures after being added to the queue.

QueueCount.description: Total number of operations added to the queue (valid for preheating and settling tasks).

SameNameFilePolicy.description: Same-name file policy. Skip: Skip files with the same name; KeepLatest: Keep the latest file; OverWrite: Overwrite files with the same name.

Status.description: Task status. Creating: Creating; Running: Running; Finished: Finished; Canceling: Canceling; Canceled: Canceled; Deleting: Deleting; Error: Error; Deleted: Deleted.

SubPath.description: Subpath under Fileset (represents the full file system path if Fileset ID is not specified).

TaskAction.description: Task type. Import: Preheating task; Export: Settling task; Inventory: Reconciliation task; Delete: Deletion task.

TlsInfo.description: TLS log information. Displayed by the server only if TLS log analysis (EnableTlsLog=true) is enabled during creation.
